description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Vi''' [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|charges]] while being [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by 15% for up to 4 seconds to increase ''Vault Breaker's'' [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] range, speed, and damage over the first 1.25 seconds of the channel.
description.text: Active: Vi charges while being slowed by 15% for up to 4 seconds to increase Vault Breaker's  range, speed, and damage over the first 1.25 seconds of the channel.

description2.raw: ''Vault Breaker'' can be recast within the duration. If the charge completes without reactivation, ''Vault Breaker'' is cancelled, [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] 50% of the mana cost is refunded, and it is placed on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] full cooldown. If the charge is [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Disruption|An icon representing the keyword Interrupt]] [[:Crowd control#Disruption|interrupted]], [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] 50% of the mana cost is refunded and it is placed on a [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] 3-second cooldown.
description2.text: Vault Breaker can be recast within the duration. If the charge completes without reactivation, Vault Breaker is cancelled,  50% of the mana cost is refunded, and it is placed on  full cooldown. If the charge is interrupted,  50% of the mana cost is refunded and it is placed on a  3-second cooldown.

description3.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Vi''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] in the target direction to deal physical damage to enemies within her path, increased by 0% – 150% (based on channel time), and [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|pull]] all non-champions hit towards her.
description3.text: Recast: Vi dashes in the target direction to deal physical damage to enemies within her path, increased by 0% – 150% (based on channel time), and pull all non-champions hit towards her.

description4.raw: She stops upon hitting an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocking them back]] over 0.75 seconds.
description4.text: She stops upon hitting an enemy champion, knocking them back over 0.75 seconds.

description5.raw: ''[[File:Vi Relentless Force.png|20xpx|border|link=Vi#Relentless Force|An icon for Vi's ability Relentless Force]] [[Vi#Relentless Force|Relentless Force]] and [[File:Vi Cease and Desist.png|20xpx|border|link=Vi#Cease and Desist|An icon for Vi's ability Cease and Desist]] [[Vi#Cease and Desist|Cease and Desist]] can be cast during the dash.''
description5.text: Relentless Force and Cease and Desist can be cast during the dash.

notes.text:
Vault Breaker's dash range extends up to 50 units when going through a wall.
Targets will be hit as soon as they come into contact with Vi.
The knockback direction will be toward Vi's facing direction regardless of where she hit the target.
Casting Flash during the dash will cause enemies at the destination to be hit by Vault Breaker.
* As Flash updates Vi's facing direction, affected champions will be knocked back in the direction the summoner spell was cast in.
Vi may cast spells that change her facing direction during the dash, including certain item actives and her own Cease and Desist, to knock champions she collides with in a different direction.(unexpected)
* Items that also initiate their own dash immediately without delay can only redirect targets struck at Vault Breaker's maximum range. These items include:
** Hextech Rocketbelt
Stuck targets (including those that block Vault Breaker with a spell shield) are briefly immune to being affected again by Vault Breaker from this player, for about 1.25 seconds.
